```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">secret hidden text</div><p>also visible</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
